name: Croton Autoblogger AI
author: Croton

sections.description:
Spending an hour creating a blog that doesn’t rank is a thing of the past. Croton Autoblogger generates SEO-optimized blogs with the keywords you need. Thanks to its algorithm and scraping system, we can create better content than your competitors. Don’t worry about images, FAQs, internal and external links, or meta descriptions. Croton Autoblogger does it all for you.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Content Generation: Leverage advanced AI to create SEO-optimized blog posts automatically
  • Free Plan: You can use the free plan to create your first posts by creating an account.
  • Easy Script Management: Create, view, and manage content generation scripts from the WordPress admin
  • SEO Optimization: Automatically generates content optimized for search engines
  • SEO Plugin Integration: Automatically fills meta keywords for Yoast SEO, RankMath, and All in One SEO
  • Media Library Integration: Automatically uploads AI-generated images to WordPress media library for better compatibility and management

– Privacy Policy: https://croton.es/privacy-policy
sections.faq:
What does the free version include?

The free version includes two blogs per month. It includes SEO-optimized text, internal and external links, slug optimization, meta title and meta description, and a frequently asked questions section. It does not include images and has a limit of up to 1,500 words per blog.

Does Google penalize AI in blogs?

No, not at all. Google values good content and responding to user needs. Autoblogger uses human language and a system that Google values positively, allowing you to increase impressions and clicks to your website.

Can I edit something on the blog when it’s ready?

You can edit whatever you need, as Croton generates the content in your template. Croton Autoblogger allows you to change anything you need, including images, text, links, or descriptions.

Will blogs fit the design of my template?

Of course. Croton Autoblogger creates blogs using your default template so you can always maintain your brand image.

How are AI photos made on blogs?

Croton Autoblogger AI analyzes each paragraph and detects the best type of photo to use. Our AI adapts to the content so that all images are consistent with the blog.
